svg.text: 05. Timeline: Session Teardown While Link Is Down — TX Queue Flush & DMA Buffer Lifetime
Paired with 05-mt_queue-and-shared_queue-before-after.svg | Non-linear time axis: "//" marks a cut | Base 15e2f411 vs. PR c5f235c3
Panel A — BEFORE (15e2f411): Unbounded Pad Flush, False Healthy Queue & Premature DMA Free -> UAF on Link Up
tv_uinit() calls mt_txq_flush(q, pad), then mt_txq_put(q)
dangling sh_info.free_cb + opaque ptr -> UAF / crash
no link check; spins pads; leaks pad refcnt (+1)
unflushed queue returned to pool for reuse
Dirty queue drains stale mbufs into live pool
no fatal-error retirement; stale mbufs stay on HW ring
waiting while tv_uinit_hw() runs unbounded pad flush
warns only; frees DMA while refcnt > 0!
DPDK decrements refcnt in freed st_frame_trans
TX ring stalled — 255 chain mbufs pinned in NIC
flush pads rejected (0 sent); descriptors cannot drain
DMA pages returned to heap / reallocated
LINK UP: NIC DMAs 255 FREED slots (UAF!)
corrupt DMA / IOMMU fault + invokes stale free_cb
Blind cleanup bug: mt_txq_done_cleanup() and mt_tsq_done_cleanup() discard rte_eth_tx_done_cleanup() return value and always return 0, hiding dead rings.
Panel B — AFTER (c5f235c3): Bounded Flush (-EBUSY), Queue Fatal-Marking & Multi-Slot DMA Retention -> Zero UAF
safe no-op callback — never touches freed session
Retired queue drains / freed at port stop
isolated from pool; new sessions get clean queues
refcnt decrements cleanly to 0; zero use-after-free
255 mbufs stay intact; refused pad refcnt refunded (-1)
LINK UP / STOP: Valid DMA + Zero UAF!
NIC reads valid pages; DPDK frees mbufs cleanly

text.tspan: mt_txq_done_cleanup() and mt_tsq_done_cleanup() now return the actual rte_eth_tx_done_cleanup() freed count (or -ENOTSUP) instead of returning 0.
mt_dpdk_flush_tx_queue() and mt_tsq_flush() pre-check mt_dev_link_down(), refund refused pad refcnt (-1), cap stalls at 64 ms, and return -EBUSY if sent_total < burst_pkts/2.

svg.text: Source: lib/src/datapath/mt_queue.c, lib/src/datapath/mt_shared_queue.c, lib/src/dev/mt_dev.c, lib/src/mt_util.c, lib/src/st2110/st_tx_video_session.c (15e2f411..c5f235c3)
